constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Before any live run, prove with a deterministic test that each new sync section is entered and exited around its sweep (the registry records the site, totalMs accumulates, exclusive nesting with an inner site does not double-count), and that a wrapped function's return value and thrown error are unchanged. Do not change the event-loop-gap-watchdog's budget thresholds, gap detection, sampling profiler enablement, or the existing cdc_update_row_fetch/cdc_insert_row_fetch sites. New site names follow the snake_case convention and lazily register.
Do not change the MovieLens 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms stability window, workload, joins, preload size, ratings-only split policy, report conversion, or live scenario semantics.
